subject_need: Bridge complete trust-policy rollout preview to governed activation and rollback.
alternative_solutions: Leave activation and rollback outside QIF and document them in prose.
Add only a human approval flag to the rollout preview.
Model activation decision, observation contract, and rollback event as distinct linked entities.
non_solution_options: Treat preview sufficiency or test count as automatic authorization.
